final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT archstat, COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) as distinct_arcref FROM scanqc WHERE arcref IS NOT NULL GROUP BY archstat), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(distinct_arcref) as sum_val FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.archstat, s1.distinct_arcref, CAST(s1.distinct_arcref AS REAL) / s2.sum_val as ratio FROM step1 s1 CROSS JOIN step2 s2 WHERE s2.sum_val IS NOT NULL), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio FROM step3) SELECT s3.archstat, s3.distinct_arcref, s3.ratio, s3.ratio - s4.avg_ratio as difference FROM step3 s3 CROSS JOIN step4 s4 WHERE s4.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL AND s3.ratio > s4.avg_ratio
